forth herein. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual agreements herein contained, and for other good and valuable
consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto agree as follows: 1. Definitions: Loan Document . Capitalized terms used herein without definition shall have the meanings assigned
to such terms in the Credit Agreement. This Amendment shall constitute a Loan Document for all purposes of the Credit Agreement and the other Loan Documents. 2. Amendment . Not suffer or permit the aggregate amount of cash in the Liquidity Accounts
(a) from October 1, 2022 to December 6, 2022 to be less than $3,000,000 at any time, (b) from December 7, 2022 to February 28, 2023 to be less than $4,500,000, and (c) from and after March 1, 2023 to be less
than $4,000,000.” 3. Expenses . The Loan Parties agree to pay all out-of-pocket and documented costs and expenses of the Agent and the Lenders (including diligence costs, consulting fees and Costs) in connection with the transactions contemplated by this Agreement invoiced
to the Borrower (including, without limitation, the reasonable and documented fees and out-of-pocket expenses of counsel to the Agent and the Lenders incurred in
connection with the negotiation, preparation, execution and delivery of this Amendment and the other Loan Documents). Without limitation of the foregoing, the Loan Parties agree to pay (a) on December 1, 2022 to the Agent’s counsel
its outstanding fees in the aggregate amount of $6,705.00 and (b) on December 8, 2022 to the Lenders’ counsel its outstanding fees in the aggregate amount of $42,813.58.

# Investment Memorandum

## 1. Executive Summary

- On December 1, 2022, Baudax Bio, Inc. and its lenders executed Amendment No. 3 to their original Credit Agreement dated May 29, 2020.
- Baudax Bio, Inc., a Pennsylvania corporation, serves as the Borrower, with guarantors including Baudax Bio N.A. LLC (Delaware) and Baudax Bio Limited (Ireland). Wilmington Trust, National Association acts as Administrative and Collateral Agent, with MAM Eagle Lender, LLC as the Lender.
- The original Credit Agreement has been previously amended twice (August 1, 2022 and October 24, 2022), indicating ongoing covenant negotiations.
- This amendment modifies liquidity account requirements, establishing tiered minimum cash thresholds: $3,000,000 from October 1 to December 6, 2022; $4,500,000 from December 7, 2022 to February 28, 2023; and $4,000,000 from March 1, 2023 onward.
- The amendment includes comprehensive waiver and release provisions by the Loan Parties in favor of the Agent and Lenders.

## 2. Investment Highlights & Risks

### Key Strengths / Credit Positives:
• Borrower maintains compliance with existing covenants and represents no Default or Event of Default has occurred
• Guarantees and security interests are reaffirmed and remain in full force and effect
• Structured liquidity covenant provides clear cash management requirements with defined time periods

### Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:
• Multiple amendments within a short timeframe (three amendments since August 2022) suggest potential financial stress or covenant management issues
• Comprehensive waiver and release language indicates prior disputes or potential claims between parties
• Stepped liquidity requirements suggest borrower may be operating under tighter cash management constraints
• Limited information available on overall financial performance, pricing terms, or facility size

• Comprehensive waiver and release language indicates prior disputes or potential claims between parties
